page.layout: One column of text on a single printed page, with a centred title and italic subtitle above it. No margin notes, running head, page number or catchword.

main_text.head: PSALMUS CXII.
main_text.p: Laudate ô serui Dominum, laudate nomen Domini.
Sit nomen Domini collaudatum, hinc usq; in sempiternum.
Ab ortu Solis usq; ad occasum collau-detur nomen Domini.
Sublimis est Dominꝰ super omnes gen-tes, & gloria eiꝰ super omnes cœlos.
Quis est sicut Dominus Deus noster, qui sese in sublime ad habitandū col-locat, ac rursum sese demittit ut con-templetur quæ in cœlo & in terra fiunt?
Eleuat de puluere egenum, & de ster-core pauperem erigit.
Ut collocet eum inter Principes, inter Principes populi sui.
Sterilem matremfamiliâs cū filijs domi lætantem facit.

page.notes: The title is set in capitals and is read as PSALMUS CXII (112); the printed V is a vowel, so it is written U. The subtitle is in italic type. The abbreviation for -usque after "vsq" is a q with a tail mark, written here as usq; with the semicolon the scan shows. The stroke after "fiunt" is read as a question mark. Each verse is set as its own paragraph because each ends with a full stop and the next verse begins on a new line; the verse lines themselves are not indented. Superscript 9 after "Domin" and "ei" is read as the -us abbreviation (ꝰ).
